sn2.3:1.2: Atha kho Māgho devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi ||
sn2.3:1.3: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Māgho devaputto Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || || 3.
